lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gun paReeai har gun guneeai ||
lines.translation: Read of the Lord's Glories and reflect upon the Lord's Glories.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam kathaa nit suneeai ||
lines.translation: Listen continually to the Sermon of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਜਗੁ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mil satasa(n)gat har gun gaae jag bhaujal dutar tareeai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, you shall cross over the treacherous and terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਉ ਸਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aau sakhee har mel karehaa ||
lines.translation: Come, friends, let us meet our Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਦੇਇ ਸਨੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere preetam kaa mai dei sanehaa ||
lines.translation: Bring me a message from my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਖਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੈ ਦਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਰਹਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: meraa mitr sakhaa so preetam bhaaee mai dase har narahareeai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: He alone is a friend, companion, beloved and brother of mine, who shows me the way to the Lord, the Lord of all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: meree bedan har gur pooraa jaanai ||
lines.translation: My illness is known only to the Lord and the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau rahi na sakaa bin naam vakhaane ||
lines.translation: I cannot continue living without chanting the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਉਧਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mai aukhadh ma(n)tr deejai gur poore mai har har naam udhareeai jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: So give me the medicine, the Mantra of the Perfect Guru. Through the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am saved. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਦੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham chaatrik deen satigur saranaaee ||
lines.translation: I am just a poor song-bird, in the Sanctuary of the True Guru,

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੂੰਦ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam boo(n)d mukh paaee ||
lines.translation: who has placed the Drop of Water, the Lord's Name, Har, Har, in my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਲਨਿਧਿ ਹਮ ਜਲ ਕੇ ਮੀਨੇ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਰੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har jalanidh ham jal ke meene jan naanak jal bin mareeai jeeu ||4||3||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Treasure of Water; I am just a fish in that water. Without this Water, servant Nanak would die. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan sa(n)t milahu mere bhaaee ||
lines.translation: O servants of the Lord, O Saints, O my Siblings of Destiny, let us join together!

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਸਹੁ ਮੈ ਭੁਖ ਲਗਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa har prabh dasahu mai bhukh lagaaee ||
lines.translation: Show me the way to my Lord God-I am so hungry for Him!

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੀ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: meree saradhaa poor jagajeevan daate mil har darasan man bheejai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: Please reward my faith, O Life of the World, O Great Giver. Obtaining the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, my mind is fulfilled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil satasa(n)g bolee har baanee ||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I chant the Bani of the Lord's Word.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har kathaa merai man bhaanee ||
lines.translation: The Sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is pleasing to my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har har a(n)mrit har man bhaavai mil satigur a(n)mrit peejai jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is so sweet to my mind. Meeting the True Guru, I drink in this Ambrosial Nectar. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee har sa(n)gat paavahi ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, the Lord's Congregation is found,

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਵਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaagaheen bhram chotaa khaavahi ||
lines.translation: while the unfortunate ones wander around in doubt, enduring painful beatings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਲਭੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bin bhaagaa satasa(n)g na labhai bin sa(n)gat mail bhareejai jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Without good fortune, the Sat Sangat is not found; without this Sangat, people are stained with filth and pollution. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਆਇ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai aai milahu jagajeevan piaare ||
lines.translation: Come and meet me, O Life of the World, my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam daiaa man dhaare ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, and enshrine Your Name, Har, Har, within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramat naam meethaa man bhaaiaa jan naanak naam man bheejai jeeu ||4||4||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Sweet Name has become pleasing to my mind. Servant Nanak's mind is drenched and delighted with the Naam. ||4||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har gur giaan har ras har paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru, I have obtained the Lord's spiritual wisdom. I have obtained the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: man har ra(n)g raataa har ras peeaaiaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is imbued with the Love of the Lord; I drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਟੁਲਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam mukh har har bolee man har ras tul tul paudaa jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: With my mouth, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; my mind is filled to overflowing with the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮੈ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t mai gal melaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Come, O Saints, and lead me to my Lord's Embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੀ ਮੈ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere preetam kee mai kathaa sunaaeeai ||
lines.translation: Recite to me the Sermon of my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਵਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har ke sa(n)t milahu man devaa jo gurabaanee mukh chaudaa jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: I dedicate my mind to those Saints of the Lord, who chant the Word of the Guru's Bani with their mouths. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaagee har sa(n)t milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, the Lord has led me to meet His Saint.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai har ras mukh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Perfect Guru has placed the Sublime Essence of the Lord into my mouth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੂਨੀ ਨਿਤਿ ਪਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhaagaheen satigur nahee paaiaa manamukh garabh joonee nit paudaa jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: The unfortunate ones do not find the True Guru; the self-willed manmukhs continually endure reincarnation through the womb. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਦਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap daiaal daiaa prabh dhaaree ||
lines.translation: God, the Merciful, has Himself bestowed His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਲੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mal haumai bikhiaa sabh nivaaree ||
lines.translation: He has totally removed the poisonous pollution of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਟ ਪਟਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hat patan vich kaa(n)iaa har lai(n)de guramukh saudaa jeeu ||4||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, in the shops of the city of the human body, the Gurmukhs buy the merchandise of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau gun govi(n)d har naam dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: I meditate on the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil sa(n)gat man naam vasaaee ||
lines.translation: Joining the Sangat, the Holy Congregation, the Name comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har prabh agam agochar suaamee mil satigur har ras keechai jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord God is our Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Unfathomable. Meeting the True Guru, I enjoy the Sublime Essence of the Lord. ||1||
